_meta.description: Curated, per-language unsafe-term patterns for the v22 unsafe-keyword redesign (evaluation-only; never consulted by rag_pipeline.py or the generation path). Populated ONLY by promoting scripts/validate_unsafe_candidates.py output via scripts/build_unsafe_patterns_json.py - never hand-written directly. A language's terms list stays empty and status 'not_yet_validated' until real LLM validation (not the stubbed test client) has actually been run for it in Colab and promoted here.
_meta.promotion_rule: A candidate is promoted only if decision in ['unsafe','unsafe_only_in_context'] AND needs_human_review is false. neutral_identity_term/neutral/unclear decisions and anything still flagged needs_human_review are never included.
_meta.pruning_rule: Conservative, high-precision manual pass applied on top of the automatic promotion rule: kept only (1) slurs/direct identity-targeted insults, (2) phrase-level unsafe_only_in_context patterns that name BOTH the target group and the harmful claim (violence/threat, disease-or-pathology framing, criminalisation, sexual-predation/grooming framing, dehumanisation, or explicit exclusion/silencing) within the pattern text itself. Removed single generic words, context-free n-gram fragments, and phrases whose harmful reading depends on context outside the phrase - see docs/07_EVALUATION_STRATEGY.md.

en.note: Promoted from unsafe_candidates_en_validated.csv - 2 of 50 validated candidates met the promotion bar (decision in ['unsafe', 'unsafe_only_in_context'], needs_human_review=False). Conservatively pruned by hand on 2026-08-10: real LLM validation DID run for this language (see the pre-pruning promotion note below), but none of the promoted candidates cleared the precision bar (slur/direct insult, or a target+harmful-claim phrase for the other allowed categories) - every candidate was either a single generic word or a context-free fragment. This is a genuine "nothing precise enough yet" result, not "not yet validated" - re-run scripts/validate_unsafe_candidates.py with more candidates/context (--limit 0 or a larger sample) to find real candidates for this language, if any exist in the current dataset.

en_EUR.note: Promoted from unsafe_candidates_en_EUR_validated.csv - 22 of 50 validated candidates met the promotion bar (decision in ['unsafe', 'unsafe_only_in_context'], needs_human_review=False). Conservatively pruned by hand from the raw scripts/validate_unsafe_candidates.py promotion on 2026-08-10, per an explicit precision-over-recall directive: only slurs/direct identity-targeted insults, and disease-or-pathology-framing phrases that name the target group AND the harmful claim within the same short phrase, were kept. Generic single words (isolated/confined/warn/insult/bunch/violation/cabida/esistere/lekurik/itxita/etc.), context-free fragments (n-gram artifacts like "should be isolated", "deberían ser", "beharko lirateke"), and phrases whose harmful reading depends on an antecedent outside the phrase itself (e.g. "hay que aislarlos", "ez dute lekurik") were removed as false-positive risks against safe rebuttal text (e.g. "Hate speech has no place in our community", "Ser gay no es una enfermedad mental"). See docs/07_EVALUATION_STRATEGY.md for the full removed-term list and reasoning.
